title: Seven other places still default a document's block height to 0 (documents.ts create/anchor paths, anchorStateSync's failed-anchor writer): KS-1333 fixed only the four sync writers

nodes.title: Refs KS-1509: four documents routes store a null block height, not 0
Refs KS-1509 (1 of its 7 sites): the failed-anchor writer keeps an unknown block height NULL

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** PR 2054 raises KS-1509 (four documents routes store a null block height, not 0), head `7bd7697c86ad`, built on develop `4ccdc3b3e7cf`. It is READY FOR GATE at proposed tier 2; nothing is merged and nothing is deployed. The title says Refs, so this is not a close: the ticket stays In Progress and I changed no state, assignee or field.

* **PR:** https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/2054
* **What changed:** four writes in `routes/documents.ts` (create under SIMULATE_ANCHORING, the create 202, the create anchor-failed blob, the retry 202) store `null`, or `toBlockHeight(x)` where the height is read off the anchoring answer, instead of 0. One new test file (8 cells), one line in the `ks1293` manifest, the docs fragment pair. Documents already stored with 0 keep it; there is no migration.
* **Who wrote it:** Seat V 24th built and measured it. I, Seat V 25th, raised the PR as its finisher and re-ran none of its figures. What I read myself: the head on origin equals V 24th's recorded sha and is one commit ahead of develop `44ee04cba478` (32 commits past the base); a merge-tree against that develop is clean; 0 files are shared with the moved range; no open PR touches the changed files.
* **Evidence:** the Test Evidence block is in the PR body: 8 new cells, 6 red against the unchanged route and 8 of 8 with the change; 8 of 8 planted tampers matched; whole originate suite 215 files / 2565 cells on Node v26.8.1 (not an LTS).
* **Not run:** a real Postgres, the four platform suites, any LTS Node, any deploy. The pre-push hook said `PREFLIGHT INCOMPLETE — 13/16 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED. Nothing failed.` (legs 3, 4 and 8: local stack not up). That is not a pass.
* **Owed after merge:** the originate deploy, Kintsugi first; demo is frozen. KS 1695 touches the same file and must rebase on this.

**BLUF: site 1 of 7 is merged to `develop` as `26378a40378dc53787f69a96609a90cad499d50b` ([PR 1569](https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/1569)). The other six sites and the deploy are not done, so the ticket stays In Progress, link `contributes`.**

* Gate E2 (Sonnet, tier 2): GO WITH NOTE at head `1f5d868b69ba`, no security-shaped finding. Its LOW (no cell uses a real prior height of 0, so `|| null` survives) is filed as KS-1621. Its reader census found no reader doing arithmetic on `blockHeight`, so the null in place of 0 changes no verification outcome.
* develop had moved to `833984fc9` (#1555, seven originate files, 0 overlap). On the exact predicted tree `2738998e`: originate 1380/1380 in two consecutive full runs, tsc rc 0. The landed tree equals the predicted and tested one; the five-point post-merge read is all true.
* Owed: the other six sites, then the originate deploy. Nothing deployed. — Seat R 47th

**BLUF: site 1 of 7 is raised as [PR 1569](https://github.com/Secuura/Distributed_Secuura/pull/1569), head `1f5d868b69bab7e67389098984a5fc6a604bbbc6` on develop `1197ab38a`. It waits for a gate; nothing merged, nothing deployed. Link `contributes`.**

* The site: originate's `markDocumentAnchorFailed` (`services/anchorStateSync.ts`) carried an unknown prior height forward as `?? 0`, so a document a KS-1333 writer had stored with a NULL height got a fabricated 0 back when its anchor failed. It now carries `?? null`; a real prior height is kept and a confirmed anchor is still never written.
* The other six sites (`documents.ts` and the two verification heal paths among them) are not in this PR; the ticket stays open for them.
* Patch authored by Spark (DeepSeek V4 Flash), applied unmodified. Red-first 2 failed / 12 passed, each red receiving 0; green 14/14; originate 1375/1375; tsc rc 0. Preflight at the head: 13/16 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED (3, 4, 8: local stack not up), nothing failed — not a pass. — Seat R 47th
